name: schoology-exporter
description: Schoology assessment results exporter for the Gains Platform (Schoology API + Playwright export -> Supabase Storage -> backend trigger)

scripts.pretest: node -e "const f=require('fs').readdirSync('tests').filter(n=>n.endsWith('.test.js'));if(!f.length){console.error('ERROR: no *.test.js files found in tests/ — the suite would have passed vacuously');process.exit(1)}console.log(f.length+' test file(s)')"
